description.short_caption: Gram stain showing budding yeast forms with pseudohyphae.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a gram stain under light microscopy, revealing round to oval yeast cells with budding forms and pseudohyphae. The yeast cells are gram-positive, appearing purple against the lighter background. The pseudohyphae are elongated structures connecting some of the yeast cells, indicative of fungal morphology. The image suggests a fungal organism, likely Candida species, based on the morphology.
